research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register text of Executive Order 12961 (60 FR 28507, PDF pages 1-2 of the 1995-05-31 issue; sha256 9068f491...), headed Executive Order 12961 of May 26, 1995, Presidential Advisory Committee on Gulf War Veterans’ Illnesses, matching the census register row (1995-05-26). Text and inventory: the machine inventory has 21 scopes (sections 1 through 4(c), with the seven matters under section 2(b) as separate items) that cover the order to the signature; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory committee. Ending: Executive Order 13138 section 3(g) revokes Executive Order 12961, as amended, effective September 30, 1999 (section 9). The report deadlines in section 2(f) and the report-relative termination in section 4(b) are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.
